description_en: Queries the details of an international flight order
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen intl-flight-order-detail --order-id 1012000000000000 --out-order-id F11374007131319304192 --btrip-user-id 10001 --buyer-name ZHANG/SAN --isv-name TRAVEL --x-acs-btrip-corp-token feth00jqwls --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou

parameters.help_en: The business travel order ID. Required

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise access token.

When calling this operation over HTTP, this parameter is required and must be appended to the request URL. For information about how to obtain the token, refer to Enterprise Access Token (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.5e2a281frQyDQ8&docId=3769985).
When appending the token, use crop_token=value instead
parameters.help_zh:
企业访问凭证。

通过 HTTP 方式调用本接口时，需要作为必填参数拼接在请求地址中。获取方式请参见：企业访问凭证 (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.5e2a281frQyDQ8&docId=3769985)。
在拼接时，推荐使用 crop_token=value 替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_corp_token
